# Bundled browser assets

These are local copies of the versions already referenced by the application, so the tested core pages do not require a CDN at runtime.

- Bootstrap 5.3.2: MIT; `bootstrap/LICENSE`.
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.1: MIT; `bootstrap-icons/LICENSE`.
- jQuery 3.7.1: MIT; `jquery/LICENSE`.
- Ace 1.32.0: BSD; `ace/LICENSE`.

Exact download URLs and SHA-256 values are recorded in `deploy/vendor-assets.json`. These files keep their upstream notices. The framework's own license is the repository's Apache-2.0 `LICENSE`.
